latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — vertical life-hack/gadget demo video generation for WeryAI.

- Generates short 9:16 vertical hack/gadget demo videos (problem–tool–payoff), using WeryAI API.
- Requires Node.js 18+, a WERYAI_API_KEY, and public HTTPS image URLs for input.
- Supports prompt expansion: always rewrites user input into a full, detailed English production prompt before API submission.
- Confirms all parameters and full expanded prompt with user before generation.
- Handles text-to-video and image-to-video flows; returns playable video URLs or clear errors.
- Default model: KLING_V3_0_PRO, 5s duration, audio off, close/medium shot, natural light.
